messages.subject: Lunchtime CLE: SDLT and TOGC update (Thursday 24 April, 1pm)
messages.plaintextBody: Join our property and tax teams for a one-hour session on recent SDLT and TOGC developments, including HMRC's latest guidance on option-to-tax notifications. Sandwiches provided. Counts towards your annual competence record. RSVP to Knowledge & Learning.
